name: Shark
role: Apex. Sets the plan every wave; everyone else reads its lane and reacts.
home: Its own lane plus a buffer band; changes every wave
habit: One per wave. Never enters from the same edge or travels the same direction two waves in a row. Picks an attitude, then a route from that attitude.

routes.name: Cruise
routes.purpose: The calm default: owns one horizontal lane at one of four heights. Allowed during Manta meetings.

routes.name: Patrol loop
routes.purpose: Loops one side and leaves the way it came, handing the other half to the mediums. Allowed during meetings.

routes.name: Deep sweep
routes.purpose: Sweeps a seat row; pushes the Octopus to the other seat row. Allowed during meetings.

routes.name: Center line
routes.purpose: Straight through the middle; splits the screen into top and bottom halves. Allowed during meetings.

routes.name: Split
routes.purpose: Top to bottom through the center. Nothing crosses the middle while it is there; each half keeps its own fish.

routes.name: Diagonal
routes.purpose: Corner to corner; mediums take the two corners it leaves open.

routes.name: Strike
routes.purpose: A short fast lunge through the middle.

routes.name: Feeding circle
routes.purpose: Circles one spot, then leaves the way it came. The only Hungry route allowed in meetings, on the far side.

routes.name: Stalker
routes.purpose: Slow wavy pass through the lower middle: a long, easy target.

routes.name: Inspector
routes.purpose: Drops in to look at one seat and climbs back out; that seat feels watched.

routes.name: Bubble check
routes.purpose: Lingers near the center with small turns.

routes.name: Charge
routes.purpose: Fast straight run across in 6-8 s: a jolt.

routes.name: Thrash
routes.purpose: Fast zigzag; looks angry and is hard to track.

reactions.name: Snap back
reactions.effect: Reverses along its own lane at 1.6x speed and leaves where it came in.

reactions.name: Frenzy
reactions.effect: 3 s of 1.5x speed with a hard side-to-side shake.

co_paths.name: Shadow
co_paths.effect: A smaller second Shark follows 2-3 s behind in the same lane.

co_paths.name: Pincer
co_paths.effect: A smaller second Shark takes the mirrored lane at the same moment, never touching.
